books.title: Dune
books.author: Frank Herbert
books.description: Set on the desert planet Arrakis, Dune is the story of the boy Paul Atreides, heir to a noble family tasked with ruling an inhospitable world where the only thing of value is the spice melange, a drug capable of extending life and enhancing consciousness.

books.title: Project Hail Mary
books.author: Andy Weir
books.description: Ryland Grace is the sole survivor on a desperate, last-chance mission—and if he fails, humanity and the earth itself are doomed. Except right now, he doesn't know that. He can't even remember his own name, let alone the nature of his assignment or how to complete it.

books.title: Neuromancer
books.author: William Gibson
books.description: Case was the sharpest data-thief in the matrix—until he crossed the wrong people and they crippled his nervous system. Now a mysterious employer recruits him for a last-chance run against an unthinkably powerful artificial intelligence.

books.title: Foundation
books.author: Isaac Asimov
books.description: For twelve thousand years the Galactic Empire has ruled supreme. Now it is dying. But only Hari Seldon, creator of the revolutionary science of psychohistory, can see into the future—to a dark age of ignorance and barbarism that will last thirty thousand years.

books.title: The Three-Body Problem
books.author: Cixin Liu
books.description: Set against the backdrop of China's Cultural Revolution, a secret military project sends signals into space to establish contact with aliens. An alien civilization on the brink of destruction captures the signal and plans to invade Earth.

books.title: Clean Code: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship
books.author: Robert C. Martin
books.description: Even bad code can function. But if code isn't clean, it can bring a development organization to its knees. Every year, countless hours and significant resources are lost because of poorly written code. This book teaches the values and practices of software craftsmanship.

books.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
books.author: Martin Kleppmann
books.description: Data is at the center of many challenges in system design today. Difficult issues need to be figured out, such as scalability, consistency, reliability, efficiency, and maintainability. This book provides a comprehensive guide through the principles and practicalities of modern data architectures.

books.title: The Pragmatic Programmer
books.author: Andrew Hunt, David Thomas
books.description: The Pragmatic Programmer cuts through the increasing specialization and technicalities of modern software development to examine the core process—taking a requirement and producing working, maintainable code that delights its users.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.description: No matter your goals, Atomic Habits offers a proven framework for improving—every day. James Clear, one of the world's leading experts on habit formation, reveals practical strategies that will teach you exactly how to form good habits, break bad ones, and master tiny behaviors.

books.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
books.author: Daniel Kahneman
books.description: In the international bestseller, Thinking, Fast and Slow, Daniel Kahneman, the renowned psychologist and winner of the Nobel Prize in Economics, takes us on a groundbreaking tour of the mind and explains the two systems that drive the way we think.

books.title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
books.author: Yuval Noah Harari
books.description: From a renowned historian comes a groundbreaking narrative of humanity’s creation and evolution—a #1 international bestseller—that explores the ways in which biology and history have defined us and enhanced our understanding of what it means to be human.

books.author: George Orwell
books.description: Winston Smith toes the Party line, rewriting history to satisfy the Ministry of Truth. With each lie he writes, Winston grows to hate the Party that seeks power for its own sake and persecutes those who dare to commit thoughtcrimes.

books.title: The Great Gatsby
books.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
books.description: The Great Gatsby, F. Scott Fitzgerald's third book, stands as the supreme achievement of his career. This exemplary novel of the Jazz Age has been acclaimed by generations of readers.

books.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
books.author: Harper Lee
books.description: The unforgettable novel of a childhood in a sleepy Southern town and the crisis of conscience that rocked it, To Kill A Mockingbird became an instant bestseller and a critical success when it was first published in 1960.

books.title: The Silent Patient
books.author: Alex Michaelides
books.description: Alicia Berenson’s life is seemingly perfect. A famous painter married to an in-demand fashion photographer, she lives in a grand house overlooking a park in one of London’s most desirable areas. One evening, she shoots her husband five times in the face and never speaks another word.

books.title: Gone Girl
books.author: Gillian Flynn
books.description: On a warm summer morning in North Carthage, Missouri, it is Nick and Amy Dunne’s fifth wedding anniversary. Presents are being wrapped and reservations are being made when Nick’s clever and beautiful wife disappears from their rented pine house.

books.title: And Then There Were None
books.author: Agatha Christie
books.description: Ten strangers are lured to an isolated island mansion off the Devon coast by a mysterious host. One by one, the guests share the darkest secrets of their wicked pasts. And one by one, they die.

books.title: The Hobbit
books.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
books.description: Bilbo Baggins is a hobbit who enjoys a comfortable, unambitious life, rarely traveling any farther than his pantry or cellar. But his contentment is disturbed when the wizard Gandalf and a company of dwarves arrive on his doorstep one day to whisk him away on an adventure.

books.title: The Name of the Wind
books.author: Patrick Rothfuss
books.description: Told in Kvothe's own voice, this is the tale of the magically gifted young man who grows to be the most notorious wizard his world has ever seen. The intimate screen of his childhood in a troupe of traveling players, his years spent as a near-feral orphan in a crime-riddled city, his daringly brazen attempt to enter a legendary school of magic.

books.title: A Game of Thrones
books.author: George R.R. Martin
books.description: Long ago, in a time forgotten, a preternatural event threw the seasons out of balance. In a land where summers can last decades and winters a lifetime, trouble is brewing. The cold is returning, and in the frozen wastes to the north of Winterfell, sinister and supernatural forces are massing.

books.title: Meditations
books.author: Marcus Aurelius
books.description: Few ancient works have been as influential as the Meditations of Marcus Aurelius, Roman emperor from A.D. 161 to 180. A series of spiritual exercises filled with wisdom, practical guidance, and profound understanding of human behavior, it remains one of the greatest works of spiritual and ethical reflection ever written.

books.title: Man's Search for Meaning
books.author: Viktor E. Frankl
books.description: Psychiatrist Viktor Frankl's memoir has riveted generations of readers with its descriptions of life in Nazi death camps and its lessons for spiritual survival. Frankl argues that we cannot avoid suffering, but we can choose how to cope with it, find meaning in it, and move forward with renewed purpose.

books.title: Educated
books.author: Tara Westover
books.description: Born to survivalists in the mountains of Idaho, Tara Westover was seventeen the first time she set foot in a classroom. Her family was so isolated from mainstream society that there was no one to ensure the children received an education, and no one to intervene when an older brother became violent.

books.title: Steve Jobs
books.author: Walter Isaacson
books.description: Based on more than forty interviews with Steve Jobs conducted over two years—as well as interviews with more than a hundred family members, friends, adversaries, competitors, and colleagues—Walter Isaacson has written a riveting story of the roller-coaster life and searingly intense personality of a creative entrepreneur.

books.title: Let Us C
books.author: Yashavant Kanetkar
books.description: The iconic, universally acclaimed guide to learning C programming in Indian engineering colleges. Renowned for its lucid explanations of pointer arithmetic, dynamic memory allocation, console graphics, recursion, bitwise operators, and structured programming fundamentals.

books.title: Programming in ANSI C
books.author: E. Balagurusamy
books.description: The quintessential introductory programming textbook across Indian university syllabi. Offers step-by-step guidance on algorithmic problem solving, structured flowcharts, arrays, user-defined functions, structures, unions, and file input/output in C.

books.title: The C Programming Language
books.author: Brian W. Kernighan, Dennis M. Ritchie
books.description: The classic 'K&R' reference manual authored by the creators of the C language. A masterclass in concise technical writing covering memory models, pointers, bit manipulation, and the standard UNIX system library interface.

books.title: Object-Oriented Programming with C++
books.author: E. Balagurusamy
books.description: A prescribed staple across B.Tech computer science and IT curricula. Introduces object-oriented programming concepts including classes, objects, data abstraction, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, virtual functions, templates, and exception handling in C++.

books.title: The C++ Programming Language
books.author: Bjarne Stroustrup
books.description: Written by the inventor of C++, this definitive masterwork details modern language features, standard template library (STL), generic algorithms, resource management via RAII, and concurrent programming.

books.title: Java: The Complete Reference
books.author: Herbert Schildt
books.description: The definitive guide to Java programming. Covers the entire Java syntax, object-oriented design principles, Java Virtual Machine internals, multithreaded programming, generics, lambda expressions, and the Java Collections Framework.

books.title: Core Java: An Integrated Approach
books.author: R. Nageswara Rao
books.description: A comprehensive reference written with university exams and technical placement interviews in mind. Covers Core Java, AWT, Swing, multithreading, JDBC connectivity, and collection frameworks with extensive code examples.

books.title: Python Crash Course: A Hands-On, Project-Based Introduction
books.author: Eric Matthes
books.description: A best-selling, thorough guide to Python programming. The first half covers fundamental concepts such as data structures, functions, classes, and file handling; the second half walks through practical real-world projects in web development, data visualization, and game creation.

books.title: Programming Python: Powerful Object-Oriented Programming
books.author: Mark Lutz
books.description: An exhaustive reference on advanced Python programming techniques. Emphasizes real-world application domains including GUI development, network protocol integration, systems administration scripting, and enterprise database integration.

books.title: JavaScript: The Definitive Guide
books.author: David Flanagan
books.description: Known as the definitive 'Rhino Book', this comprehensive manual covers modern ECMAScript standards, closures, prototypes, asynchronous promises, async/await, Document Object Model (DOM), Node.js, and web APIs.

books.title: Data Structures and Algorithms in C
books.author: Reema Thareja
books.description: Widely regarded as the standard textbook for Data Structures across Indian engineering colleges. Details arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, sorting algorithms, searching mechanisms, and algorithmic complexity with step-by-step C implementations.

books.title: Data Structures Using C and C++
books.author: Yedidyah Langsam, Moshe J. Augenstein, Aaron M. Tenenbaum
books.description: The time-tested foundational textbook on data representation, dynamic memory management, recursion, binary search trees, B-trees, graph traversals, and hashing techniques.

books.title: Introduction to Algorithms (CLRS)
books.author: Thomas H. Cormen, Charles E. Leiserson, Ronald L. Rivest, Clifford Stein
books.description: The internationally acclaimed authority on algorithms. Combines mathematical rigor with comprehensive analysis of sorting algorithms, advanced data structures, graph theory, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, and NP-completeness.

books.title: Database System Concepts
books.author: Abraham Silberschatz, Henry F. Korth, S. Sudarshan
books.description: The cornerstone textbook for database management systems across universities worldwide. Covers the relational model, SQL queries, entity-relationship schemas, normalization theory (1NF through BCNF), transaction processing, concurrency control, and recovery.

books.title: Operating System Concepts
books.author: Abraham Silberschatz, Peter B. Galvin, Greg Gagne
books.description: Widely known as the 'Dinosaur Book', this classic offers an in-depth treatment of operating system design, processes and threads, CPU scheduling algorithms, mutual exclusion and deadlocks, memory management, virtual memory paging, and storage architectures.

books.title: Computer Networks
books.author: Andrew S. Tanenbaum, David J. Wetherall
books.description: The gold standard textbook on computer networking. Explores networking architectures from the physical layer up to the application layer, covering fiber optics, data link protocols, IP routing algorithms, TCP congestion control, and network security.

books.title: Data Communications and Networking
books.author: Behrouz A. Forouzan
books.description: Celebrated for its intuitive, visual diagrams and pedagogical approach. Thoroughly explains signal transmission, digital modulation, error detection and correction, subnetting, IPv4/IPv6 architectures, and socket programming.

books.title: Computer System Architecture
books.author: M. Morris Mano
books.description: The quintessential engineering textbook detailing digital hardware organization, register transfer micro-operations, central processing unit control design, pipelining, memory hierarchy, and input/output asynchronous data transfer.

books.title: Digital Logic and Computer Design
books.author: M. Morris Mano
books.description: The classic foundational book for digital electronics and computer hardware engineering. Covers Boolean algebra, Karnaugh mapping, logic gate simplification, combinational circuits (adders, multiplexers, decoders), and sequential flip-flop counters.

books.title: Software Engineering: A Practitioner's Approach
books.author: Roger S. Pressman, Bruce R. Maxim
books.description: The world's foremost authority on professional software engineering practices. Covers agile methodologies, software process models, requirement engineering, UML architectural design, software testing suites, and project metrics.

books.title: Theory of Computer Science: Automata, Languages and Computation
books.author: K.L.P. Mishra, N. Chandrasekaran
books.description: A prescribed guide in Indian universities for automata theory, regular expressions, finite state automata, context-free grammars, pushdown automata, Turing machines, and Chomsky hierarchy of languages.

books.title: Compilers: Principles, Techniques, and Tools
books.author: Alfred V. Aho, Monica S. Lam, Ravi Sethi, Jeffrey D. Ullman
books.description: Universally known as the 'Dragon Book', this is the defining work on compiler construction, lexical analyzers (Lex), syntax parsers (Yacc/Bison), syntax-directed translation, intermediate code generation, and compiler optimization.

books.title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach
books.author: Stuart Russell, Peter Norvig
books.description: The premier global textbook on artificial intelligence. Examines rational agents, search algorithms (A*, minimax), constraint satisfaction, knowledge representation, probabilistic inference, deep learning architectures, and natural language processing.

books.title: Cryptography and Network Security: Principles and Practice
books.author: William Stallings
books.description: An authoritative guide to cybersecurity engineering. Covers symmetric key ciphers (DES, AES), public-key cryptography (RSA, ECC), cryptographic hash functions, digital signatures, IPSec, TLS/SSL, and malicious software defense mechanisms.

books.title: Web Technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP
books.author: Uttam K. Roy
books.description: The standard B.Tech university text for Web Technologies. Explains HTML5, CSS3, DOM scripting with JavaScript, XML, server-side programming using PHP, and MySQL database connectivity with hands-on lab exercises.

books.title: Higher Engineering Mathematics
books.author: B.S. Grewal
books.description: The legendary, most widely issued textbook in Indian engineering college libraries. A comprehensive masterwork covering linear algebra, differential and integral calculus, vector calculus, ordinary and partial differential equations, Fourier series, Laplace transforms, and numerical analysis.

books.title: Basic Electrical and Electronics Engineering
books.author: V.K. Mehta, Rohit Mehta
books.description: Essential first-year engineering textbook explaining DC and AC circuit theory, electromagnetic induction, single-phase and three-phase transformers, semiconductor diodes, bipolar junction transistors, and operational amplifiers.

books.title: Cloud Computing: Concepts, Technology & Architecture
books.author: Thomas Erl, Ricardo Puttini, Zaigham Mahmood
books.description: Authoritative reference text on cloud computing architecture, infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS), PaaS, SaaS, containerization, hypervisors, multitenancy, cloud storage mechanisms, and distributed resiliency.

reviews.title: A towering sci-fi masterpiece
reviews.comment: The world-building on Arrakis is unmatched. Frank Herbert created a layered socio-political and ecological epic that resonates more with every re-read.

reviews.title: Could not put it down!
reviews.comment: Andy Weir strikes gold again. Ryland and Rocky have the best dynamic in modern speculative fiction. Hilarious, smart, and uplifting science.

reviews.title: Essential fundamentals for developers
reviews.comment: Solid foundational principles on functions, naming, and structure. Some Java specifics are aged, but the overarching mindset is timeless.

reviews.title: Hauntingly prophetic
reviews.comment: Orwell’s vision of psychological control and linguistic erosion through Newspeak is chillingly relevant. A vital read for every generation.

reviews.title: Actionable and transformative
reviews.comment: Clear, concise frameworks on habit stacking and environmental design. Genuinely shifted how I organize my daily reading and study habits.

reviews.title: Timeless guidance for inner calm
reviews.comment: The journal of an emperor grappling with duty, humility, and mortality. Reading one page a day brings extraordinary perspective.

reviews.title: Cleared all my pointer concepts in 1st year!
reviews.comment: Yashavant Kanetkar's explanations and end-of-chapter exercises are legendary. Must-read for every engineering student preparing for lab exams.

reviews.title: Gold standard for DBMS coursework
reviews.comment: The chapters on SQL, BCNF normalization, and ACID transaction isolation are crystal clear. Invaluable for semester exams and GATE.

reviews.title: The B.Tech engineering math bible
reviews.comment: B.S. Grewal is the most essential book in the college library. Covered all our differential equations and Laplace transform problems perfectly.

reviews.title: Timeless Dinosaur Book
reviews.comment: CPU scheduling, semaphores, and virtual memory paging explained with unmatched depth. Essential for systems engineering.
